## Motivation

Hybrid linear-attention models (GDN/Mamba + full-attention) like Qwen 3.5 and Kimi-Linear have O(n) linear-attention layers but still retain O(n²) full-attention layers whose KV cache dominates GPU memory at long contexts. This limits the practical context length on commodity GPUs (e.g. 24 GB RTX 3090).
